OUR ICE POP MOLDS ARE SAFE AND USER FRIENDLY - Made of 100% BPA free plastic, our ice pop molds match Tupperware’s quality for long lasting use in your home. Our popsicle molds are oversized to hold more treats but stand securely in a tray that fits your freezer. Easy to serve one at a time or serve the whole tray! And, they are top rack dishwasher safe.

CREATE EASY HEALTHY POPSICLES - Our Mamasicles offer includes hundreds of FREE recipes for easy healthy ice cream treats for yourself, your kids and your friends. Use natural fruits, juices, yogurts, along with other ingredients and flavors that your family loves. It is super easy and fun to make popsicles. Use them all year around.

NO MORE STICKY HANDS - These popsicles molds have a drip tray at the base of each one to catch the drips, so no more sticky hands! The slotted holes in the stick secure the stick in the popsicle, making it easy to remove the popsicle from the mold. Just follow directions on the box for easy removal.
